summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans in Phase 66 (API Schema Cutover, Publish Gate & Tombstone) using wave-based parallel subagents across 5 waves, validating TEE-04/05/07, DATA-01/02/03/04, and WRITE-04 requirements.
summary.outcome: 8/9 plans fully completed with green API build and full monorepo typecheck. Migration applied to live DB and 4/5 e2e proof tests pass; Test 15 (TEE-05 seqFloor serve path) exposed a genuine gap where the at-floor resolve path can't produce a client-verifiable record.

repo: worktree.baseRef is set to 'head' — worktrees fork from live HEAD, so inter-wave merges don't cause base-mismatch halts
The deletion guard in worktree-safety.cjs is unconditional with no override flag; any branch containing file deletions requires a manual merge
api:generate's trailing lint:fix runs eslint repo-wide, so it exits non-zero when web/sdk-core are in a known-broken intermediate state (expected between waves)
apps/api/.env sets DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test — the test database name is NOT 'cipherbox'
users.publicKey stores the 130-char uncompressed secp256k1 auth key (04... prefix), not a shorter or compressed form
TEST_LOGIN_SECRET in apps/api/.env is 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only', not the sdk-e2e harness default 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production'

TypeORM 0.3.28 has a duplicate-row false no-op bug: a duplicate WidenShareKeyType1743100000000 row in the migrations table caused it to report 'no pending migrations' despite ApiSchemaCutover never having run
The sdk-e2e test:single script uses --testPathPattern (a jest flag) which was removed in vitest 3.x; it is silently broken
API seqFloor-serve path (resolve) returns the delegated-routing network record, which per design is stripped of signature fields — the strict sdk-core client always rejects it

code.finding: Orphaned ShareKey import and entity registration — not cleaned up by 66-01 (which handled IpnsRecord rename) or 66-03 (which deleted the entity). Required an orchestrator-level post-merge fix.
Also imported the deleted ShareKey entity; a second orphan from 66-03's deletion not covered by any plan's files_modified list.

seqFloor resolve path: when signedRecord IS NULL and networkSeq >= storedSeq, serves the delegated-routing network record. The code's own comment at 627-628 acknowledges these records 'do NOT carry the signature fields a strict client needs to verify', meaning TEE-05's availability direction (at-floor → serve) silently fails closed on every sdk-core client.

psqlExec/psqlQueryOne helpers hardcoded '-d cipherbox' instead of the API's actual test database 'cipherbox_test', causing Test 15 precondition seeding to write to the wrong DB and the user-lookup to return empty.

workflow: When a post-merge build is intentionally red (intermediate type-foundation state), run a targeted package build and extract unique error file paths to confirm errors are confined to the next wave's declared files_modified scope — don't run the full monorepo build

Stale unit tests after a behavioral rewrite (mock lacks new query builder methods) are best fixed by a focused sub-agent with an explicit 'production code is authoritative' guardrail rather than inline orchestrator edits
D-08 pattern: subagents must not run concurrent e2e suites to avoid RAM starvation; the orchestrator runs them centrally after all wave executors complete
For vitest-based e2e suites, invoke vitest directly with a positional pattern (e.g., vitest ipns-publish-gate) rather than using package.json scripts that may have stale jest flags

When applying migrations fails via TypeORM, applying DDL directly in a psql BEGIN...COMMIT transaction and inserting the migration record manually is a valid workaround — but the duplicate row that triggered the false no-op should be cleaned up separately

friction: Worktree deletion guard has no override flag, forcing manual merge for any wave where plans delete files (happened in both Wave 1 and Wave 2)
Two orphaned ShareKey references (app.module.ts, generate-openapi.ts) were missed by all plans — discovered only during post-merge build gates, requiring ad-hoc orchestrator fixes
sdk-e2e test:single script is silently broken (jest flag removed in vitest 3.x) with no error message indicating the cause
e2e test-login secret mismatch between harness default and API .env required debugging a 401 mid-gate-run
TypeORM duplicate migration row caused false 'no pending migrations' report, requiring DDL applied directly via psql — obscure failure mode with no obvious diagnostic in the TypeORM output
66-09's psql helpers hardcoded the wrong database name, requiring an orchestrator-level diagnosis and fix to unblock Test 15
28 unit tests in ipns.service.spec became stale after 66-02 replaced findOne/save with createQueryBuilder atomic UPDATE — required a separate sub-agent dispatch to realign them
open_items: TEE-05 genuine gap: the seqFloor-serve path at apps/api/src/ipns/ipns.service.ts:587-628 returns a network record without signature fields; the strict sdk-core client always fails closed on shared-folder at-floor resolves. Design spec §6.5 says it should serve — this needs a follow-up fix before Phase 66 can be fully verified.
Test 15 (seqFloor resolve case-split) remains failing pending the TEE-05 gap fix; the full 5/5 e2e proof suite is not yet achieved
Duplicate WidenShareKeyType1743100000000 row in the migrations table should be cleaned up to prevent future TypeORM false no-op reports
Web Phase 68: 66-08 placed compile-gate throw-stubs in share.service.ts, invite.service.ts, and ShareDialog.tsx — real web share/invite rework explicitly deferred
ROT-07 (durable high-water mark via IndexedDB/journal for generation tracking): explicitly deferred to Phase 68, not in Phase 66 scope
